$comment: What each kind of agent work needs from a model. The kit names no models: `configure-models` reads this, finds what the user can reach, and writes ~/.flutter-kit/models.json; `kit install` pins the result into every harness and `kit loop` runs from it. Every agent in agents/ belongs to exactly one role (validate-kit.py check 21).

explore.needs: Reliable tool calls and a large context window; almost no judgement. Runs constantly, so the cheapest model that searches well.

build.needs: Strong at code and at multi-step tool use: edits, runs the analyzer and tests, reads the failures, fixes. The loop's builder and fixer, so it carries most of the volume.

judge.needs: The best judgement available: design decisions, a screen built from an underspecified design, root causes, and the escalated review of a one-way door. Rare, so quality first.

review.needs: Reads a diff against acceptance criteria and standards and finds what is wrong. A different model family from build, so the two do not share blind spots.

qa.needs: Follows a procedure exactly: runs the suite, drives each criterion, files bugs. Moderate judgement, low volume.

loop.$comment: The roles `kit loop` runs headless, each as its own process, so each may use a different harness.
